newsitem.title: USA: MCI, BT file for merger approval.
newsitem.headline: MCI, BT file for merger approval.

text.p: MCI Communications Corp and British Telecommunications Plc said on Tuesday that they have filed an application with the U.S. Federal Communications Commission for approval of their proposed merger.

The companies said in their application to the FCC that as a result of the merger, MCI is expected to accelerate its entrance in the U.S. local telephone market, a market now dominated by the regional Bell operating companies.
They said the merger is also expected to advance the opening of foreign markets to telecommunications competition.
MCI and BT also said that the openness of the U.K. telecommunications market meets the FCC's requirements for approving the proposed transaction.
In the filing, they said that the U.K. telecommunications market meets key competitive criteria.

They said U.S. carriers shortly will have the ability to provide U.K. international-facilities based services because 45 international licenses are expected to be issued by the end of the year, including more than a dozen to U.S. companies.

They said the U.K. domestic telecommunications market provides fair interconnection terms and is fully open to U.S. carriers, noting that AT&T Corp, Sprint Corp, NYNEX Corp, U S West Communicsations Group and other companies already operate in the U.K.
According to the companies, the U.K. has an effective regulatory framework and competitive safeguards protect against anticompetitive practices in the U.K.
